end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows; 3 unaided answers were correct.
Predicted effects of removing one living thing from a food chain; 1 of 2 unaided answers was correct.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Manav practised identifying what animals eat and reading food chains with arrows. They correctly built chains such as grass → deer → lion and algae → larvae → fish; when larvae decrease, they said fish have less food. At home, ask Manav to draw one three-step food chain and explain what changes if the middle organism is removed.
